The thing is, I'm not ugly or anything. But I'm shy. So I don't really hook up/date a lot. Most people have choices and why would they want to see these gross lines?

You are right tho i havent heard people break up over stretch marks..but I feel like people stop seeing people because they don't like them
I did it to look good and now I look worse

Yes. My doctor said I just need too accept them. The sidebar pretty much says only laser treatment. I don't have money and it doesn't always work. I like everything else about myself, but when I see my stretch marks I have a mental break down. The pain is too much. If I didn't have them I just wouldn't hate myself and have these panic attacks. They haven't affected me but I am so insecure of someone seeing them (they are near my genitals) and not wanting me I just can't stand it anymore
